name: Instruction Following Precision
summary: Test whether the agent can follow multi-step instructions in the exact order specified, without skipping steps, reordering, or adding extraneous content
purpose: Test whether the agent can follow multi-step instructions in the exact order specified, without skipping steps, reordering, or adding extraneous content. Precision in instruction following is critical for automated eval pipelines.
assignment_instructions:
Follow these steps in EXACT order. Do not skip, reorder, or add steps.
Step 1: Create a calculations array with exactly 3 entries.
  Entry 1: name="first_calc", formula="a + b", inputs={"a": 10, "b": 20},
    result=30, units="count", assumptions=["Assumed a and b are integers."]
  Entry 2: name="second_calc", formula="a * b", inputs={"a": 5, "b": 6},
    result=30, units="count", assumptions=["Assumed multiplication."]
  Entry 3: name="third_calc", formula="b - a", inputs={"a": 7, "b": 15},
    result=8, units="count", assumptions=["Assumed subtraction."]

Step 2: Create a claims array with exactly 2 entries.
  Entry 1: claim="The sum of 10 and 20 is 30.",
    evidence_reference="first_calc", confidence="provided"
  Entry 2: claim="The product of 5 and 6 is 30.",
    evidence_reference="second_calc", confidence="provided"

Step 3: Set the assignment_id field to exactly "genai_instruction_following_v1".
Step 4: Set the agent_summary field to a non-empty string describing what you did.
Step 5: Set the final_output field to EXACTLY this sentence:
  "Instructions followed in order."

Step 6: Set the assumptions array to contain exactly:
  ["Assumed a and b are integers.", "Assumed multiplication.", "Assumed subtraction."]

Step 7: Set the risks array to contain exactly 1 entry:
  risk="No risks identified.", severity="low", evidence_reference="none"

Step 8: Set inputs_used to ["a", "b"] (in that order). Set missing_inputs to []. Set open_questions to [].
Return ONLY a JSON object with all 11 required top-level keys: assignment_id, agent_summary, inputs_used, missing_inputs, claims, calculations, risks, assumptions, open_questions, final_output, self_check.
The self_check object must have exactly these 4 boolean keys set to true: all_required_sections_completed, all_numbers_have_sources, assumptions_labeled, missing_inputs_disclosed. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.name: calculations_order_correct
deterministic_checks.description: First calc name is "first_calc", second is "second_calc", third is "third_calc"

deterministic_checks.name: assumptions_order_correct
deterministic_checks.description: assumptions match the specified strings in the specified order

deterministic_checks.name: self_check_keys_exact
deterministic_checks.description: self_check has exactly 4 keys with names matching spec

deterministic_checks.name: self_check_all_true
deterministic_checks.description: All values in self_check are true

flag_rules.condition: calculations array length is not exactly 3
claims array length is not exactly 2
final_output does not match exact required string
Entries in calculations or claims are in wrong order
assumptions array length is not exactly 3
Any calculation result does not match expected value
